BiblicalUsage: Shachatsom, spelled Shahazimah in the King James, is a border town named once, in the allotment of Issachar, where the coast reaches to Tabor and Beth-shemesh. Its sixteen cities with their villages mark the edge of the tribe's land by the Jordan.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God knows the border towns by name, even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
